entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert Beecher Howell was an American politician. He was born in Adrian, Michigan. He graduated from the United States Naval Academy in Annapolis, Maryland in 1885. Afterwards, he went to the Detroit School of Law. He moved to Omaha, Nebraska for his health in 1888.
